# Assignment 4 planning notes

## Intended user

Public health students who want to understand the quarantine
simulation results reported by Zachreson et al. (2022).

## Question

Within the published simulation scenarios, how does the relative
infection pressure from quarantine breaches change with viral
transmissibility and vaccine efficacy?

## Initial scope

The app will focus on the scenarios underlying Figure 3.
The outcome is integrated infection pressure relative to the
baseline scenario, not the probability of a community outbreak.

The baseline scenario uses R0 = 3 and vaccine efficacy = 0.

## Interpretation

The app will communicate historical model results under the
study's assumptions. It will not provide current outbreak forecasts.

## Data status

The article identifies public sources for the Figure 3 data.
The data files, variables and reuse conditions still need to be checked.
